---
title: Crostini with Truffles
id: MAR-0028
lang: en
source_lang: it
servings: 4
time_min: 30
difficulty: medium
---
## Ingredients
- 8 slices of country bread
- 80 g white truffles
- 60 g butter
- 5 anchovy fillets
- 1 garlic clove
- 1 tablespoon parsley
- 2 tablespoons extra virgin olive oil
- to taste salt and pepper
## Method
1. Melt the anchovy fillets over low heat in the oil and 30 g of butter; add the parsley and the peeled garlic and mix.
2. Clean the truffles and slice them, add them to the mixture and continue cooking for about 8 minutes.
3. Toast the bread slices under the oven grill for a few minutes, until they are golden.
4. Add the remaining butter to the mixture, remove the garlic, season with salt and pepper, then turn off the heat.
5. Spread the hot crostini with the truffle cream and serve.
